landing.heroDescription: A unified healthcare platform that helps patients, doctors, organizations, and administrators coordinate care and essential medical support during conflict.

about.heading: Coordinating healthcare when every connection matters
about.description: HCMS brings patients, doctors, healthcare organizations, and administrators into one coordinated system designed to support medical follow-up, communication, resource coordination, and continuity of care during conflict and emergency conditions.

connectedCare.title: Connected Care
connectedCare.description: Keep patients and healthcare providers connected throughout follow-up.

coordinatedResources.title: Coordinated Resources
coordinatedResources.description: Help healthcare organizations coordinate assistance and available resources.

continuityOfCare.title: Continuity of Care
continuityOfCare.description: Keep essential medical information and follow-up organized across the care journey.

features.heading: Built for coordinated healthcare delivery
features.introduction: Essential tools for managing care, communication, assistance, and critical events in one connected platform.

medicalRecords.title: Medical Records
medicalRecords.description: Organize essential patient medical information and follow-up history.

treatmentFollowUp.title: Treatment Follow-up
treatmentFollowUp.description: Support treatment plans, medications, appointments, and medical notes.

doctorPatientCoordination.title: Doctor–Patient Coordination
doctorPatientCoordination.description: Keep assigned doctors and patients connected throughout active care.

assistanceResources.title: Assistance & Resources
assistanceResources.description: Coordinate assistance requests and resource allocation between patients and healthcare organizations.

emergencyAlerts.title: Emergency Alerts
emergencyAlerts.description: Surface critical situations quickly so the appropriate teams can respond.

secureCommunication.title: Secure Communication
secureCommunication.description: Support communication between patients and their assigned healthcare providers.

whoWeServe.heading: Care coordination for every role
whoWeServe.description: HCMS connects patients, doctors, healthcare organizations, and administrators within one coordinated system that supports care across every role.

patients.title: Patients
patients.description: Stay informed and connected throughout the care journey.

capabilities.treatmentTracking: Follow treatment plans, medications, and appointments
capabilities.assistanceAlerts: Request assistance and send emergency alerts

doctors.title: Doctors
doctors.description: Coordinate ongoing care for assigned patients.

capabilities.carePlanning: Manage medical notes and treatment plans

organizations.title: Healthcare Organizations
organizations.description: Coordinate assistance and resources where they are needed.

capabilities.careContinuity: Support continuity of care during conflict and emergencies

administrators.title: Administrators
administrators.description: Oversee users, activity, and essential system operations.

capabilities.systemOversight: Oversee the system and its activities
